mapper.select: select commission_id, member_id, order_id, order_no, level, amount, status, remark, settle_time, create_time from hys_commission where order_id = #{orderId} order by level desc
mapper.insert: insert into hys_commission (member_id, order_id, order_no, level, amount, status, remark, settle_time, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{level}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{settleTime}, now())
mapper.update: update hys_commission set status = #{status} where commission_id = #{commissionId}
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from hys_commission where status = 1
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from hys_commission where status = 1 and create_time >= #{start}
select count(1) from hys_commission where status = #{status}
